question: What invoice total does ishosting.com's checkout produce for the Lite 1-year term?
why: the site has no guest cart page (/en/cart answers its Not Found (404) page on 2026-11-07) and the order flow's checkout runs inside the account application, so the final total (fees, taxes) is readable only with an account; the order page's payment ladder (1 Month $6.99/month to 1 Year $5.94/month -15%) is the pre-checkout price
